method.files: git ls-files -z -- crates. Only tracked workspace sources; dependencies and generated artifacts excluded.
method.rust_lines: Physical lines in .rs files, including comments, blanks and tests. Final newline does not add an extra line.
method.unsafe_blocks: Matches of the Rust unsafe keyword followed by an opening brace in those .rs files. Zero matches; the workspace forbids unsafe code.
method.tests: cargo nextest list --workspace --release --locked --build-jobs 2 --message-format json; testcases with ignored=false. Includes each compiled binary target; excludes doctests.

historical_robustness.source: Project-owner supplied report of the latest kernel, matched against our own hard-test corpus.
historical_robustness.scope: Historical source-run figures, not a measurement of this public revision. The measured source changes are not in the public starting tree. Raw source-run artifacts are not included here; these totals are owner-reported, not independently reproduced by this site capture.
historical_robustness.speed_comparisons: Not measured. No cross-kernel speed comparison is claimed.
